items.question: Are you available for new projects?
items.answer: Yes — I'm currently open for freelance projects and collaborations. Send me a message and I'll reply within a day with availability and next steps.

items.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
items.answer: Web applications, marketing sites, e-commerce stores, dashboards, APIs, and internal tools — anything that lives on the web and needs to work well.

items.question: How does a typical project start?
items.answer: We start with a short call or chat to understand your goals. Then I send a clear scope with milestones and estimates before any code is written.

items.question: Do you work with existing codebases?
items.answer: Absolutely — I can audit, fix, extend, or gradually modernize existing projects. Clean handovers and readable code are part of the job.

items.question: Can you handle design as well?
items.answer: I can turn your designs into pixel-accurate interfaces, or design clean functional UIs myself for early-stage products and internal tools.

contact.title: Let's work together
